label: Self-reported health-related quality of life measures (SF-36) - Bodily pain index (0-100) - at age 60-64 years
meta_rows: Self-reported health-related quality of life measures (SF-36) - Bodily pain index (0-100) - at age 60-64 years

SF36 is a widely used, self-reported health-related quality of life measures made up of 36 items, 35 of which are used to derive sub-scales and components scores. One item (HT) indicates health transition and should be used as a categorical variable pending further research.
